I have used Samsung Galaxy S2, Motorola X (2nd gen) and Redmi 3 prime. Hence my review is based on comparison with these phones -
  

  Pros -
  
  1. very fast, snappy experience
  
  2. 3gb ram and 32 gb rom
  
  3. UI - vanilla Android without any bloatware
  
  4. Looks
  
  5. Gps, 3g, 4g, call quality very clear and loud
  

  Cons -
  
  1. Battery backup
  
  2. Slight heating problem
  

  I am not sure how this phone stacks up against others at this price but I am very satisfied with the phone and would strongly recommend to someone looking to buy a phone at this price point.

Performence of this phone is very good after six month the phone performing flawlessly. But a little problem occurs sometime, phone takes ghost touch, though I am not touching or tapping into the screen it starts operating automatically, I think it is a software glitch and panasonic india should look over it. The camera performance is average. Processor and ram performance is very good I played to much games and found the gaming performance flawless. But the phone gets warm when I played high graphics game though the gaming run flawlessly. Battery is not good of this phone it drains very fast and capacity is very low for this kind of phone. The display is protected by Ashai Dgagontail glass  which is not as good as Corning Gorila glass 3, so the display protection is not hard like gorila glass 3. It can,t tolerate lignt pressure, my phone display broken within 6 month though it never fallen from my hand. An awsome phone in this budget for moderate smartphone users.

So this was my experience with the phone for couple of days and I'll explain why you should probably go for this phone.
  

  Pros:
  
  *64gb ROM(it gives around 54gb of free space)
  

  *4gb RAM (Amazing Speed)
  

  *Snapdragon Octacore Processor (any game with no lag at all)
  

  *16MP Back and 8MP front with flash on both sides(Camera quality of both are Amazing,trust me don't read those comments saying camera isn't good. If they don't know how to do some fine settings it's their problem)
  

  *Removable Back panel and it's Duel Sim, which means you can put duel Sim and SD card at the same time(unlike nowadays with hybrid sim)
  

  *LED light Notification display
  

  *ARBO Virtual Smart assistant technology(First Indian virtual assistant if I'm not wrong)
  

  *Duel Sim with 4g VOLTE  capacity for both and ther bands also
  

  *Headphone Volume and equalizer are good
  

  *3000 Mah with fast charge (within 30min you'll have 100% charge)
  

  *Fingerprint unlock
  

  *stylish design and this has smart gesture also
  

  Cons:
  

  Screen size is 5 2 inch which could've been 5.5 but still it doesn't make that big of difference
  

  *slight overheat while using fast charge (it won't make big deal as well)
  

  *Down there's a stereo speaker visible in which there is only 1 mono speaker on the right side and no speaker at all on left side and the volume is bit less (They should've made it stereo)
  

  *fingerprint sometimes unlocks when it's kept in pocket for some reason so keeping the screen facing the other side will fix it.
  

  *No slowmo cam but still you can download an alternate app

  1. Great value for money (full hd screen, fast charging, 4 GB ram, 32 GB rom, decent processor) at this price point.
  
  2. 5.2 inch screen. Not very large or bulky, fits better in the pocket compared to 5.5 inch screen phones. Easy to operate with one hand for surfing and reading.
  
  3. Stock android interface and smart actions like double tap to wake and sleep, extending the life of the start button.
  

  Top 3 things I disliked:
  
  1. The auto brightness feature does not seem to work properly.
  
  2. Picture quality - especially that from the primary camera. Glaring lack of detail.
  
  3. Lack of capacitative keys, except the fingerprint scanner / back button. The on-screen navigation bar could have been avoidable.

Writing this review after 3 days of usage in a hope that this would be useful to anyone who wants to know about phone from actual user who has used/bought this.
  

  Bought this phone (32 GB Variant) for Rs 8,549 (2000 Off bt Flipkart + 950 Off by using HDFC Credit Card).
  

  Snail Paced Delivery: Ordered on 18th May but order was accepted by seller only after 3 days and received this phone on 23rd May (5 days to ship to Chennai, Atrocious!).
  

  I am power/heavy user with lots of apps & lots of customization, I see slight lag in this phone despite being brand new phone with 4GB RAM. But for normal user, there shouldn't be any noticeable lag.
  

  Form Factor: Slim and sturdy, using phone without any back cover or tempered glass.
  

  Build Quality   Good.
  

  Screen   Awesome.
  

  Call Quality: Good, No heating issue during calls.
  

  Heavy Apps Usage: When you push phone too hard, it heats up a bit which is pretty normal for all phones. No complaints on this.
  

  Battery: Heats up while charging (I saw my battery app showing 50C temp). Battery drains faster than I expected. Presume 3000mAH is not less for such high processor and RAM device. You may have to frequently recharge this phone.
  

  Fast Charging Option: Charges till 70% under 25 mins.. It took 1 Hour 20 mins to charge from 8% to 100%. Fast charging is bit erratic, sometimes it shows fast charging message, sometimes no indication about fast charging. I don't see any option to do normal charging.
  

  Front / Back Camera : Good in bright light (Just good can't be rated as excellent), not good indoor, bad in low light.
  
  Speaker Sound : Very very bad during phone call. We can say that this phone do not have speaker option during call. Did not expect this from you Panasonic. Good & Loud when using music player / FM Radio.
  
  Jio Voice Call (VoLTE calls with internet): This phone do support Jio VoLTE calls or SMS without internet however this feature is bit tricky to get it started. I struggled a lot to figure this out, try many different options at last by chance noticed that disabling and enable SIM Card Slot (Under SIM Card Menu) did the trick. Note: We need to get HD symbol next to signal, this HD indicates we can do VoLTE calls. I noticed that this HD vanishes after reboot, which means you can make calls or send SMS, again you need to disable-enable SIM to get HD symbol.
  
  Headphone: We need to thank Panasonic for giving headphone (Other brands do not give headphones). Headphone is good for handsfree calls, but sound quality is average to below average if used to listen music.
  

  Good Features : 2 Micro SIM slot with Dedicated SD card Slot.
  
  Gyroscope is not available. Although phone specs states it has Gyroscope, I was not able to detect Gyroscope using 2-3 apps.
  
  Fingerprint Sensor: Yet to be used.
  
  Arbo: You will get this after a 130 MB (Approximate) software update. Yet to get input from Arbo.
  

  Overall I am happy about this phone except for the in-call low speaker volume (Reduced 1 star for that).
  
  Hope this review was useful to know about this phone.

  It's the best phone you can buy at this price. So go for it unless you have a higher budget...

That pink dot represents litmus paper which changed color from white to pink if comes into contact with water, i.e. my phone is water damaged. Though never used it in rain/very wet atmosphere ever. Anyway they charged me Rs. 500/- and replaced the battery connector. As per them there is issue with battery connector that's why phone is unable to draw sufficient power, hence doing restart and going into optimizing mode.   After that service the problem has reoccur ed starting yesterday.  Disgusted now.
  

  Opinion: Don't go for this product. It's battery is very bad and don't even last for a year of normal usage. Company like Panasonic is taking customers as granted.

column6: Probably not the best phone in this price secgment
column7:
At the time of writing this review I have used this phone for almost 5 days.
  
  I exchanged with my Mi4i. Got the product within 2 days of order.
  
  Pros :
  
  Looks great in hand and has a stylish back panel.
  
  Speakers are quite loud and this has impressed me a lot. You can easily hear it in the other room.
  
  Output from the 3.5 mm audio jack is also good.
  
  3GB of RAM ensures that there is no lag while multitasking.
  
  1.3 GHz Quad Core processor can handle most of the games. Remember, LCD is just an HD display so there is not much load on processor during gameplay.
  
  Heats very less. The only time it heated up a bit was when I put it on charge with 4G, Hotspot and GPS on.
  
  Battery backup is the best in this range. I left my home at 9 in the morning at full charge. 4G was on the whole day and a bit of normal usage, I returned at night around 11 with still 72% of juice left.
  
  Battery backup is great. Battery drops at about 5% an hour with 4G and hotspot ON.
  
  Network connectivity is good and has a rich call experience.
  
  A dedicated MicrSD card slot is also provided.
  
  Display quality is good (not the best) but still the brightness level is impressive.
  
  Fast charging charges the phone in a jiff.
  

  Cons:
  
  Not a great camera at this price segment. Front looks okayish but the pictures from the rear camera disappointed me a bit. Camera struggles in the low light condition. Maybe an OTA update will fix this.
  
  A bit on the heavier side with around 180 grams of weight.
  

  Improvements:
  
  System UI needs to be improved. It stopped responding a couple of times. Maybe an OTA update will fix this.
  
  Camera department needs a lot of work.
  

  I'd recommend this phone to those who are not a camera enthusiast.

column6: Not like the Panasonic that we have seen before :(
column7:
Good phone, nice look and feel. But missing video call over VoLTE and heating issue. Will update after a weeks usage.
  

  Note: Panasonic should seriously consider providing Video call support from phone dialer, like their earlier models.
  
  Pros:
  
  1. good Price for features it provides.
  
  2. Nice look and feel.
  
  3. Decent battey life.
  
  4. Fingerprint scanner is good.
  
  Cons:
  
  1. Phone Dialer supports voice calls only, no Video calls over VoLTE (defeats the purpose of using this phone for VoLTE). Also, it does not allow to use JIO 4G voice app to make calls (voice or video). Better take any 4G phone and install JIO 4G Voice app.
  
  Panasonic is known to provide video call from phone dialer, this model is unbecoming of it.
  
  2. Battery, charger heating up and phone heating up even for a short call or using camera or watching video for a short time, it behaving like Motorola :(. Panasonic has always been away from heating problem but this model is an exception.
  
  3. Looks a little delicate and slippery in hand.
  
  4. Speakers should have been at the bottom and not at the back.

After using for a week the mains cons ive found are.
  
  1) I had to format my 64gb memory card although it shows data perfectly in other mobiles while in elug ray it was shown corrupt. So had to backup and format the data. Afterwards it worked perfectly.
  
  2) Abnormal heating found when chargen with MI 20000mah (old) powerbank. Reached 50 degrees. Wire was also hot to touch at that time.
  
  3) The battery calibration is poor. Sometimes drops too quickly while in pocket and seems to slow down while using. Donno whats the main culprit, the calibration or the background processes.  Panasonic has to take care of the issue. But it gives me around 1 day of charge with heavy usage.
  
  4) Seems like everyone getting 8 out of 10 attempts in fingerprint access to be correct while in my case ive found 5 out of 10 attempts only.
  
  5) PES2017 is laggy due to the quad core used in this handset. Other games worked fine although havent tested other high intensity ones. Might give the same results. Gaming experience is good and not much enjoyable to be honest.
  
  6) both Cameras are bit laggy and pictures taken are just ok. Not much to tell u here as front flash adds a plus point in this price segment.
  
  7) A dolby equaliser support could hav been added.
  
  8) ARBO has no role. LOL all those gimmicks. I dont find any use of it and neither it troubles me anytime, so no probs .
  
  9) couldnt find tempered glass and cover for this mobile in mumbai streets. Had to finally order from online.
  

  Well thats it those were the cons and lets jump to the pros
  

  Pros:
  
  1) Space grey and black combination is just wow.
  
  2) HD screen is damn crystal clear at 320+ppi.
  
  3) Sounds are clear and audible both while in call as well as in loudspeaker.
  
  4) front flash
  
  5)charging takes below 2hrs and that too without any fast charging support is good to be honest.
  
  6) Calling, selfies(not a fan), playing music, playing games and much more .This handset serves all the basics and seems like panasonic started from the scratch and built the mobile upon the basics. Kuddos to that. On average 1.3 gb of ram is used after installing all basic softwares and games.
  
  7) A dedicated memory card slot supporting  till 64gb card.
  

  Well thats a genuine review. For less budget people dont think much as this is a good phone only. Not much cons and pros to be honest but serves well for day to day use. I personally hav used asus zenfone2 32b and find this one much pleasing to hold. Please do update the O.S as i too had the system process crashing screen issue and that was solved by doing a OTA software update.
  
  Giving four stars ,(three stars + one star) for the timely delivery and the cons are just negligible as i have researched about pros and cons of other handsets too at this price segment which they are having.

column6: Not like the Panasonic that we have seen before :(
column7:
Good phone, nice look and feel. But missing video call over VoLTE and heating issue. Will update after a weeks usage.
  

  Note: Panasonic should seriously consider providing Video call support from phone dialer, like their earlier models.
  
  Pros:
  
  1. good Price for features it provides.
  
  2. Nice look and feel.
  
  3. Decent battey life.
  
  4. Fingerprint scanner is good.
  
  Cons:
  
  1. Phone Dialer supports voice calls only, no Video calls over VoLTE (defeats the purpose of using this phone for VoLTE). Also, it does not allow to use JIO 4G voice app to make calls (voice or video). Better take any 4G phone and install JIO 4G Voice app.
  
  Panasonic is known to provide video call from phone dialer, this model is unbecoming of it.
  
  2. Battery, charger heating up and phone heating up even for a short call or using camera or watching video for a short time, it behaving like Motorola :(. Panasonic has always been away from heating problem but this model is an exception.
  
  3. Looks a little delicate and slippery in hand.
  
  4. Speakers should have been at the bottom and not at the back.

After using for a week the mains cons ive found are.
  
  1) I had to format my 64gb memory card although it shows data perfectly in other mobiles while in elug ray it was shown corrupt. So had to backup and format the data. Afterwards it worked perfectly.
  
  2) Abnormal heating found when chargen with MI 20000mah (old) powerbank. Reached 50 degrees. Wire was also hot to touch at that time.
  
  3) The battery calibration is poor. Sometimes drops too quickly while in pocket and seems to slow down while using. Donno whats the main culprit, the calibration or the background processes.  Panasonic has to take care of the issue. But it gives me around 1 day of charge with heavy usage.
  
  4) Seems like everyone getting 8 out of 10 attempts in fingerprint access to be correct while in my case ive found 5 out of 10 attempts only.
  
  5) PES2017 is laggy due to the quad core used in this handset. Other games worked fine although havent tested other high intensity ones. Might give the same results. Gaming experience is good and not much enjoyable to be honest.
  
  6) both Cameras are bit laggy and pictures taken are just ok. Not much to tell u here as front flash adds a plus point in this price segment.
  
  7) A dolby equaliser support could hav been added.
  
  8) ARBO has no role. LOL all those gimmicks. I dont find any use of it and neither it troubles me anytime, so no probs .
  
  9) couldnt find tempered glass and cover for this mobile in mumbai streets. Had to finally order from online.
  

  Well thats it those were the cons and lets jump to the pros
  

  Pros:
  
  1) Space grey and black combination is just wow.
  
  2) HD screen is damn crystal clear at 320+ppi.
  
  3) Sounds are clear and audible both while in call as well as in loudspeaker.
  
  4) front flash
  
  5)charging takes below 2hrs and that too without any fast charging support is good to be honest.
  
  6) Calling, selfies(not a fan), playing music, playing games and much more .This handset serves all the basics and seems like panasonic started from the scratch and built the mobile upon the basics. Kuddos to that. On average 1.3 gb of ram is used after installing all basic softwares and games.
  
  7) A dedicated memory card slot supporting  till 64gb card.
  

  Well thats a genuine review. For less budget people dont think much as this is a good phone only. Not much cons and pros to be honest but serves well for day to day use. I personally hav used asus zenfone2 32b and find this one much pleasing to hold. Please do update the O.S as i too had the system process crashing screen issue and that was solved by doing a OTA software update.
  
  Giving four stars ,(three stars + one star) for the timely delivery and the cons are just negligible as i have researched about pros and cons of other handsets too at this price segment which they are having.

column3: Panasonic Eluga Ray Max (Rose Gold, 32 GB)
column7:
The good things :
  
  1) Display is good.
  
  2) Build quality is decent.
  
  3) No bloatware. Almost stock android.
  
  4) Fast Charging.
  
  5) gorilla glass protection. Not many phones come with this these days.
  
  6) Satisfactory camera in good lighting. Not so good in low lighting. Specially front camera is below average in low lights. My 2 years old Moto G3 has better camera.
  
  7) Call quality is decent. Not very loud earpiece. Not even at full volume. Will be difficult in noisy environments.
  
  8) dual sim with dedicated memory card slot
  
  The bad ones :
  
  1) Heats up during charging to a point where it is difficult to hold in hand.
  
  2) The biggest issue is VERY LOW loud speaker volume during call when put in speaker mode. Practically you can assume there is no loud speaker for calls. Its that bad. But the loud speaker volume is decent during youtube/music play. It indicates there is no hardware problem but it is software issue.
  
  3) Very bad audio quality for recorded videos. Looks like the noise cancellation microphone is overdoing its job. No option to disable noise cancellation.
  
  4) Very slow bluetooth data transfer. Initiated a 5mb song transfer from motog3, after 2 minutes 20% transfer completed. Immediately cancelled and used shareit.
  
  5) Finger print sensor is not that good. The positioning is such that it will be an issue for those with larger thumbs. as it can scan only a portion of thumb, you need to be very careful in placing the thumb on sensor for this to work in single shot.
  
  6) Not very loud earpiece during calls. Not even at full volume. Will be difficult in noisy environments.
  
  I dont think panasonic has put any genuine R&D in making this phone. (Possibly the software is also outsourced to some other service company)
  
  Most probably a rebranded Off the shelf phone.
  
  Google BLU LIFE 1 X2. both are same phones.
  

  So should you buy this phone?
  
  At original cost of 11499, DEFINITELY NOT. (I got it for 8549 after all discounts. But still better options are there)
  
  Are there better phones present in same range?
  
  Yes : Lenovo looks relatively more promising with Motorola R&D teams backing them up.
  
  Shall I buy another Panasonic phone?
  
  No. Wanted to give panasonic a try. But disappointed.
  
  Hope this helped.

column3: Panasonic Eluga Ray Max (Rose Gold, 32 GB)
column7:
Writing this review after 3 days of usage in a hope that this would be useful to anyone who wants to know about phone from actual user who has used/bought this.
  

  Bought this phone (32 GB Variant) for Rs 8,549 (2000 Off bt Flipkart + 950 Off by using HDFC Credit Card).
  

  Snail Paced Delivery: Ordered on 18th May but order was accepted by seller only after 3 days and received this phone on 23rd May (5 days to ship to Chennai, Atrocious!).
  

  I am power/heavy user with lots of apps & lots of customization, I see slight lag in this phone despite being brand new phone with 4GB RAM. But for normal user, there shouldn't be any noticeable lag.
  

  Form Factor: Slim and sturdy, using phone without any back cover or tempered glass.
  

  Build Quality   Good.
  

  Screen   Awesome.
  

  Call Quality: Good, No heating issue during calls.
  

  Heavy Apps Usage: When you push phone too hard, it heats up a bit which is pretty normal for all phones. No complaints on this.
  

  Battery: Heats up while charging (I saw my battery app showing 50C temp). Battery drains faster than I expected. Presume 3000mAH is not less for such high processor and RAM device. You may have to frequently recharge this phone.
  

  Fast Charging Option: Charges till 70% under 25 mins.. It took 1 Hour 20 mins to charge from 8% to 100%. Fast charging is bit erratic, sometimes it shows fast charging message, sometimes no indication about fast charging. I don't see any option to do normal charging.
  

  Front / Back Camera : Good in bright light (Just good can't be rated as excellent), not good indoor, bad in low light.
  
  Speaker Sound : Very very bad during phone call. We can say that this phone do not have speaker option during call. Did not expect this from you Panasonic. Good & Loud when using music player / FM Radio.
  
  Jio Voice Call (VoLTE calls with internet): This phone do support Jio VoLTE calls or SMS without internet however this feature is bit tricky to get it started. I struggled a lot to figure this out, try many different options at last by chance noticed that disabling and enable SIM Card Slot (Under SIM Card Menu) did the trick. Note: We need to get HD symbol next to signal, this HD indicates we can do VoLTE calls. I noticed that this HD vanishes after reboot, which means you can make calls or send SMS, again you need to disable-enable SIM to get HD symbol.
  
  Headphone: We need to thank Panasonic for giving headphone (Other brands do not give headphones). Headphone is good for handsfree calls, but sound quality is average to below average if used to listen music.
  

  Good Features : 2 Micro SIM slot with Dedicated SD card Slot.
  
  Gyroscope is not available. Although phone specs states it has Gyroscope, I was not able to detect Gyroscope using 2-3 apps.
  
  Fingerprint Sensor: Yet to be used.
  
  Arbo: You will get this after a 130 MB (Approximate) software update. Yet to get input from Arbo.
  

  Overall I am happy about this phone except for the in-call low speaker volume (Reduced 1 star for that).
  
  Hope this review was useful to know about this phone.

column7:
When I unboxed it, and was just holding it in my hands, the phone realized that theres a human holding it. So it powered on without me even pressing the power button.
  

  This phone has a really speedy fast charger. The disappointing thing is that it heats up a lot.
  

  It doesn't come with a regular charger.
  

  Earphones are good. I don't use earphones, but they sound good to me.
  

  Camera is OK. Flash on Front cam is good feature...
  

  Fingerprint is very convenient to hold. Fast enough for me... But it sometimes doesn't detect my finger. But those cases are rare.
  

  On some other phones, the camera, bluetooth or wifi would lag. That doesn't happen on this one...
  

  Battery is good enough for 1 day normal use. It runs on Android 6.0.1 Marshmallow, where there is a real power saver. With that it should last longer, it's useful while traveling.
  

  Touch is very smooth. The screen doesn't become dirty. The finger print sensor will become though...
  

  Although this phone actually has only 1 speaker, the sound is really good. Very loud, clear sound.
  

  The best thing about this phone is that is has 64GB internal storage. So you don't even need an SD card now!
  

  Internet connection is good. The back cover acts as the antenna. So, don't hold it tightly...
  

  With 4 GB RAM and a 1.4 GHz Octa COre processor, this phone is as good as a high end device!
  

  Lots of sensors. They all work very well...
  

  I have installed 160 apps, and the pre-installed apps are all up to date. And the phone hasn't lagged. (It hanged once, but that was Facebook Messenger's fault).
  

  A nice thing is that it's pure Android. Straight from Google. With no bloatware.
  

  There are some not so nice things about this, the "CE1313" mark at the back makes it look a bit ugly. The USB port is at the bottom of the phone, so that can be frustrating if you use your phone while charging. It's a heavy phone! Very heavy... But after just 3 days I got used to it...
  

  It's the best phone you can buy at this price. So go for it unless you have a higher budget...

column3: Panasonic Eluga Ray Max (Rose Gold, 32 GB)
column7:
I decided to buy this one in the big 10 sale just for a change from xiaomi phones which I have been using since they came to India.
  
  The change has been a little disappointing one. Let me list down the pros and cons of the Panasonic Eluga Ray Max and leave the final decision upto the reader:
  
  1. Bad Rear Camera. One of the poorest since I bought my 1st mobile(in low light)
  
  2. Better than average selfie camera(the front flash helps)
  
  3. ARBO is overhyped, its irritating rather than helping. Switched it off in 3 days.
  
  4. Build quality seems below par
  
  5. Bezels are huge, my redmi note 4 with a 5.5 inch display is only a couple of milimeters taller.
  
  6. If they placed a physical home button below the screen, why the other physical buttons are absent. Sheer wastage of space on the display and below that too. God knows who got the credit for such a poor design.
  
  7. A single LED flash with an average rear camera is a deadly combination. The Flash is not sufficient as a torch even.
  
  8. Quick charge, the quality of the charger & handsfree are the positives of the device
  
  9. The phone heats up immensely while charging but cools down quickly when the charger is removed. This is not a disappointment as you would hardly charge the phone beyond an hour or so.
  
  10. The battery lasts for nearly a day with heavy usage
  
  11. The back is removable, with two SIM slots and a separate memory card slot, which is a positive
  
  12. There is no built in cleaner or a backup app which is not good.
  
  13. You would find no more than 1.3GB of free RAM ever, out of the 4GB. God knows what eats up this much RAM.  My redmi note 4 always has 2.2-2.5GB free(even with a ROM having heavy bloatware, as the experts call the MIUI, its much better than the stock android as per me)
  
  14. The display, touch & call quality is no doubt good but only that much is not sufficient at the price point that Panasonic wants to sell this phone at
  
  15. The front fingerprint scanner is preferred by me. Although it is a little slow to respond, but is accurate.
  
  16. The volume rockers & power key seem a little delicate and respond a little slow.
  
  17. Everytime you reboot the device, it announces loud, "PANASONIC". God knows why? Haven't seen even an apple do that
  
  18. The speaker is placed very well with the charging jack. The output is a bit below par though. Not very disappointing
  

  Hope I help the next interested buyers make an educated decision

After using for a week the mains cons ive found are.
  
  1) I had to format my 64gb memory card although it shows data perfectly in other mobiles while in elug ray it was shown corrupt. So had to backup and format the data. Afterwards it worked perfectly.
  
  2) Abnormal heating found when chargen with MI 20000mah (old) powerbank. Reached 50 degrees. Wire was also hot to touch at that time.
  
  3) The battery calibration is poor. Sometimes drops too quickly while in pocket and seems to slow down while using. Donno whats the main culprit, the calibration or the background processes.  Panasonic has to take care of the issue. But it gives me around 1 day of charge with heavy usage.
  
  4) Seems like everyone getting 8 out of 10 attempts in fingerprint access to be correct while in my case ive found 5 out of 10 attempts only.
  
  5) PES2017 is laggy due to the quad core used in this handset. Other games worked fine although havent tested other high intensity ones. Might give the same results. Gaming experience is good and not much enjoyable to be honest.
  
  6) both Cameras are bit laggy and pictures taken are just ok. Not much to tell u here as front flash adds a plus point in this price segment.
  
  7) A dolby equaliser support could hav been added.
  
  8) ARBO has no role. LOL all those gimmicks. I dont find any use of it and neither it troubles me anytime, so no probs .
  
  9) couldnt find tempered glass and cover for this mobile in mumbai streets. Had to finally order from online.
  

  Well thats it those were the cons and lets jump to the pros
  

  Pros:
  
  1) Space grey and black combination is just wow.
  
  2) HD screen is damn crystal clear at 320+ppi.
  
  3) Sounds are clear and audible both while in call as well as in loudspeaker.
  
  4) front flash
  
  5)charging takes below 2hrs and that too without any fast charging support is good to be honest.
  
  6) Calling, selfies(not a fan), playing music, playing games and much more .This handset serves all the basics and seems like panasonic started from the scratch and built the mobile upon the basics. Kuddos to that. On average 1.3 gb of ram is used after installing all basic softwares and games.
  
  7) A dedicated memory card slot supporting  till 64gb card.
  

  Well thats a genuine review. For less budget people dont think much as this is a good phone only. Not much cons and pros to be honest but serves well for day to day use. I personally hav used asus zenfone2 32b and find this one much pleasing to hold. Please do update the O.S as i too had the system process crashing screen issue and that was solved by doing a OTA software update.
  
  Giving four stars ,(three stars + one star) for the timely delivery and the cons are just negligible as i have researched about pros and cons of other handsets too at this price segment which they are having.

column6: Probably not the best phone in this price secgment
column7:
At the time of writing this review I have used this phone for almost 5 days.
  
  I exchanged with my Mi4i. Got the product within 2 days of order.
  
  Pros :
  
  Looks great in hand and has a stylish back panel.
  
  Speakers are quite loud and this has impressed me a lot. You can easily hear it in the other room.
  
  Output from the 3.5 mm audio jack is also good.
  
  3GB of RAM ensures that there is no lag while multitasking.
  
  1.3 GHz Quad Core processor can handle most of the games. Remember, LCD is just an HD display so there is not much load on processor during gameplay.
  
  Heats very less. The only time it heated up a bit was when I put it on charge with 4G, Hotspot and GPS on.
  
  Battery backup is the best in this range. I left my home at 9 in the morning at full charge. 4G was on the whole day and a bit of normal usage, I returned at night around 11 with still 72% of juice left.
  
  Battery backup is great. Battery drops at about 5% an hour with 4G and hotspot ON.
  
  Network connectivity is good and has a rich call experience.
  
  A dedicated MicrSD card slot is also provided.
  
  Display quality is good (not the best) but still the brightness level is impressive.
  
  Fast charging charges the phone in a jiff.
  

  Cons:
  
  Not a great camera at this price segment. Front looks okayish but the pictures from the rear camera disappointed me a bit. Camera struggles in the low light condition. Maybe an OTA update will fix this.
  
  A bit on the heavier side with around 180 grams of weight.
  

  Improvements:
  
  System UI needs to be improved. It stopped responding a couple of times. Maybe an OTA update will fix this.
  
  Camera department needs a lot of work.
  

  I'd recommend this phone to those who are not a camera enthusiast.

   sound quality is very good, very loud and clear

But the loud speaker volume is decent during youtube/music play. It indicates there is no hardware problem but it is software issue.
  
  3) Very bad audio quality for recorded videos. Looks like the noise cancellation microphone is overdoing its job. No option to disable noise cancellation.

Writing this review after 3 days of usage in a hope that this would be useful to anyone who wants to know about phone from actual user who has used/bought this.
  

  Bought this phone (32 GB Variant) for Rs 8,549 (2000 Off bt Flipkart + 950 Off by using HDFC Credit Card).
  

  Snail Paced Delivery: Ordered on 18th May but order was accepted by seller only after 3 days and received this phone on 23rd May (5 days to ship to Chennai, Atrocious!).
  

  I am power/heavy user with lots of apps & lots of customization, I see slight lag in this phone despite being brand new phone with 4GB RAM. But for normal user, there shouldn't be any noticeable lag.
  

  Form Factor: Slim and sturdy, using phone without any back cover or tempered glass.
  

  Build Quality   Good.
  

  Screen   Awesome.
  

  Call Quality: Good, No heating issue during calls.
  

  Heavy Apps Usage: When you push phone too hard, it heats up a bit which is pretty normal for all phones. No complaints on this.
  

  Battery: Heats up while charging (I saw my battery app showing 50C temp). Battery drains faster than I expected. Presume 3000mAH is not less for such high processor and RAM device. You may have to frequently recharge this phone.
  

  Fast Charging Option: Charges till 70% under 25 mins.. It took 1 Hour 20 mins to charge from 8% to 100%. Fast charging is bit erratic, sometimes it shows fast charging message, sometimes no indication about fast charging. I don't see any option to do normal charging.
  

  Front / Back Camera : Good in bright light (Just good can't be rated as excellent), not good indoor, bad in low light.
  
  Speaker Sound : Very very bad during phone call. We can say that this phone do not have speaker option during call. Did not expect this from you Panasonic. Good & Loud when using music player / FM Radio.
  
  Jio Voice Call (VoLTE calls with internet): This phone do support Jio VoLTE calls or SMS without internet however this feature is bit tricky to get it started. I struggled a lot to figure this out, try many different options at last by chance noticed that disabling and enable SIM Card Slot (Under SIM Card Menu) did the trick. Note: We need to get HD symbol next to signal, this HD indicates we can do VoLTE calls. I noticed that this HD vanishes after reboot, which means you can make calls or send SMS, again you need to disable-enable SIM to get HD symbol.
  
  Headphone: We need to thank Panasonic for giving headphone (Other brands do not give headphones). Headphone is good for handsfree calls, but sound quality is average to below average if used to listen music.
  

  Good Features : 2 Micro SIM slot with Dedicated SD card Slot.
  
  Gyroscope is not available. Although phone specs states it has Gyroscope, I was not able to detect Gyroscope using 2-3 apps.
  
  Fingerprint Sensor: Yet to be used.
  
  Arbo: You will get this after a 130 MB (Approximate) software update. Yet to get input from Arbo.
  

  Overall I am happy about this phone except for the in-call low speaker volume (Reduced 1 star for that).
  
  Hope this review was useful to know about this phone.

I decided to buy this one in the big 10 sale just for a change from xiaomi phones which I have been using since they came to India.
  
  The change has been a little disappointing one. Let me list down the pros and cons of the Panasonic Eluga Ray Max and leave the final decision upto the reader:
  
  1. Bad Rear Camera. One of the poorest since I bought my 1st mobile(in low light)
  
  2. Better than average selfie camera(the front flash helps)
  
  3. ARBO is overhyped, its irritating rather than helping. Switched it off in 3 days.
  
  4. Build quality seems below par
  
  5. Bezels are huge, my redmi note 4 with a 5.5 inch display is only a couple of milimeters taller.
  
  6. If they placed a physical home button below the screen, why the other physical buttons are absent. Sheer wastage of space on the display and below that too. God knows who got the credit for such a poor design.
  
  7. A single LED flash with an average rear camera is a deadly combination. The Flash is not sufficient as a torch even.
  
  8. Quick charge, the quality of the charger & handsfree are the positives of the device
  
  9. The phone heats up immensely while charging but cools down quickly when the charger is removed. This is not a disappointment as you would hardly charge the phone beyond an hour or so.
  
  10. The battery lasts for nearly a day with heavy usage
  
  11. The back is removable, with two SIM slots and a separate memory card slot, which is a positive
  
  12. There is no built in cleaner or a backup app which is not good.
  
  13. You would find no more than 1.3GB of free RAM ever, out of the 4GB. God knows what eats up this much RAM.  My redmi note 4 always has 2.2-2.5GB free(even with a ROM having heavy bloatware, as the experts call the MIUI, its much better than the stock android as per me)
  
  14. The display, touch & call quality is no doubt good but only that much is not sufficient at the price point that Panasonic wants to sell this phone at
  
  15. The front fingerprint scanner is preferred by me. Although it is a little slow to respond, but is accurate.
  
  16. The volume rockers & power key seem a little delicate and respond a little slow.
  
  17. Everytime you reboot the device, it announces loud, "PANASONIC". God knows why? Haven't seen even an apple do that
  
  18. The speaker is placed very well with the charging jack. The output is a bit below par though. Not very disappointing
  

  Hope I help the next interested buyers make an educated decision

column3: Panasonic Eluga Ray Max (Rose Gold, 64 GB)
column7:
The good things :
  
  1) Display is good.
  
  2) Build quality is decent.
  
  3) No bloatware. Almost stock android.
  
  4) Fast Charging.
  
  5) gorilla glass protection. Not many phones come with this these days.
  
  6) Satisfactory camera in good lighting. Not so good in low lighting. Specially front camera is below average in low lights. My 2 years old Moto G3 has better camera.
  
  7) Call quality is decent. Not very loud earpiece. Not even at full volume. Will be difficult in noisy environments.
  
  8) dual sim with dedicated memory card slot
  
  The bad ones :
  
  1) Heats up during charging to a point where it is difficult to hold in hand.
  
  2) The biggest issue is VERY LOW loud speaker volume during call when put in speaker mode. Practically you can assume there is no loud speaker for calls. Its that bad. But the loud speaker volume is decent during youtube/music play. It indicates there is no hardware problem but it is software issue.
  
  3) Very bad audio quality for recorded videos. Looks like the noise cancellation microphone is overdoing its job. No option to disable noise cancellation.
  
  4) Very slow bluetooth data transfer. Initiated a 5mb song transfer from motog3, after 2 minutes 20% transfer completed. Immediately cancelled and used shareit.
  
  5) Finger print sensor is not that good. The positioning is such that it will be an issue for those with larger thumbs. as it can scan only a portion of thumb, you need to be very careful in placing the thumb on sensor for this to work in single shot.
  
  6) Not very loud earpiece during calls. Not even at full volume. Will be difficult in noisy environments.
  
  I dont think panasonic has put any genuine R&D in making this phone. (Possibly the software is also outsourced to some other service company)
  
  Most probably a rebranded Off the shelf phone.
  
  Google BLU LIFE 1 X2. both are same phones.
  

  So should you buy this phone?
  
  At original cost of 11499, DEFINITELY NOT. (I got it for 8549 after all discounts. But still better options are there)
  
  Are there better phones present in same range?
  
  Yes : Lenovo looks relatively more promising with Motorola R&D teams backing them up.
  
  Shall I buy another Panasonic phone?
  
  No. Wanted to give panasonic a try. But disappointed.
  
  Hope this helped.

column6: Panasonic Eluga Ray Max - powerful price at affordable price
column7:
Panasonic Eluga Ray Max comes with ARBO, Panasonic's new smart assistant. I loved the capable front camera which also has a LED Flash as it supports user selfie needs with precise results.
  

  The smartphone sports a metallic unibody design and also sports the Arbo assistant built by the Company, to help for efficient utilization of the smartphone. The assistant will help you locate places and as well help carry out the task.
  

  Eluga Ray Max is available in Space Grey, Rose Gold and Gold coloured variants going for around Rs. 11499 for the 32GB onboard storage type and Rs. 12499 for the 64GB built-in storage version. It presents a diagonal landscape with a field area of 5.2 inches which has adopted panel IPS LCD Capacitive Touchscreen color depth of up to 16 million colors.
  

  The screen can produce quality images that are brilliant and bright. The advantages of this phone have also been equipped with Full HD 1080 x 1920 pixels resolution in density reaches 424 ppi per inch so that the display image is so sharp and charming. Even the surface of the screen also has support multitouch is so responsive and has been provided with a scratch-resistant layer Corning Gorilla Glass 3 with 2.5D glass display Curved Glass.
  

  The smartphone is powered by an Octa-Core Qualcomm Snapdragon 430 chipset with a 64-bit processor. The GPU is Adreno 505 to handle the graphics demand. 8 Core Processor is working with 4 GB RAM so as to produce a responsive and reliable performance. Even multitasking and computing runs without lag and smoothly in processing heavy applications or games.

  The front camera and front flash works well. And the rear one is just above average.
  

  Another plus point is its design. I have the Gold color. But I think it feels a bit heavy in my hand.

  There is very very light (mild) heat ONLY at the time of charging. When i gone through some review, the heat is like IRON BOX, but not in my case.  Finger cross, need to wait & see over the period of time. As per me this is just negligible.
  
  This heat could be since, charge will complete just within 45 minutes. I checked with some other adapter, there is no heat at all, but battery charging takes hours to reach 100%. (i tested this for an hour & swapped the charging adapters, so writing here)
  

  After using continuous 2 hours internet, 40% battery completed, remaining was 60%.
  

  Starting watching after full recharge, i watched 6.30 hours continuous movies over internet with HIGH DISPLAY, battery remained was 12%.
  

  Camera quality is just awesome [front & rare], both flashes are working. There were many more setting for CAMERA FEATURE.
  

  I took this mobile, because of QUALCOMM processor, which is having in many costly mobiles.
  

  There were 2 seperate speakers, 1 for while listening music, watching movies etc etc.. another for while calling/talking with someone. Both are superb.
  

  If you listen music with ear phones, quality of ear phone is just uncomparable. You might think, how i am saying. Regular SONY product music lovers (my colleagues/friends) confirmed this to me.
  

  Finally,  the product received as per specifications.
  

  If you compare this product with all other mobile brands, all specifications are very high. May be someone has to spend 25k+ in other brands.
  

  4GB RAM,

column6: Very Good Mobile but not Excellent
column7:
After using it for 15 days here are my reviews. Cons first
  

  Cons:
  
  1. Very low audio while on speaker phone mode. You can barely hear.
  
  2. Image processing/saving libraries having some bug. Saved images from camera are grainy. Camera sensor is very good quality and renders crisp and clear  images and video on screen but due to library bug when saved, images turns grainy and dull.
  
  3. Shipped screen protection is bigger than mobile.
  

  Pros:
  
  1. Fast charger with standard USB port is excellent choice over new C-type port. You can find standard USB charger more in numbers than C-type. (Does someone has thin-pin charger for nokia).
  
  2. Dedicated micro SD card slot not like MI's hybrid.
  
  3. Two micro SIM slots.
  
  4. 3000mAh battery lasts (drops from 100% to 50%) in 3 days in my hand. I am lite user.
  
  5. My hands are small and this 5.2" mobile fits nicely. I can operate it comfortably.
  
  6. Do not come with pre-installed blotwares and un-necessary applications.
  
  7. I rely more on Japanese than Chinese products. Japanese products are more robust, stable and long lasting than Chinese.

column3: Panasonic Eluga Ray Max (Rose Gold, 64 GB)
column7:
Writing this review after 3 days of usage in a hope that this would be useful to anyone who wants to know about phone from actual user who has used/bought this.
  

  Bought this phone (32 GB Variant) for Rs 8,549 (2000 Off bt Flipkart + 950 Off by using HDFC Credit Card).
  

  Snail Paced Delivery: Ordered on 18th May but order was accepted by seller only after 3 days and received this phone on 23rd May (5 days to ship to Chennai, Atrocious!).
  

  I am power/heavy user with lots of apps & lots of customization, I see slight lag in this phone despite being brand new phone with 4GB RAM. But for normal user, there shouldn't be any noticeable lag.
  

  Form Factor: Slim and sturdy, using phone without any back cover or tempered glass.
  

  Build Quality   Good.
  

  Screen   Awesome.
  

  Call Quality: Good, No heating issue during calls.
  

  Heavy Apps Usage: When you push phone too hard, it heats up a bit which is pretty normal for all phones. No complaints on this.
  

  Battery: Heats up while charging (I saw my battery app showing 50C temp). Battery drains faster than I expected. Presume 3000mAH is not less for such high processor and RAM device. You may have to frequently recharge this phone.
  

  Fast Charging Option: Charges till 70% under 25 mins.. It took 1 Hour 20 mins to charge from 8% to 100%. Fast charging is bit erratic, sometimes it shows fast charging message, sometimes no indication about fast charging. I don't see any option to do normal charging.
  

  Front / Back Camera : Good in bright light (Just good can't be rated as excellent), not good indoor, bad in low light.
  
  Speaker Sound : Very very bad during phone call. We can say that this phone do not have speaker option during call. Did not expect this from you Panasonic. Good & Loud when using music player / FM Radio.
  
  Jio Voice Call (VoLTE calls with internet): This phone do support Jio VoLTE calls or SMS without internet however this feature is bit tricky to get it started. I struggled a lot to figure this out, try many different options at last by chance noticed that disabling and enable SIM Card Slot (Under SIM Card Menu) did the trick. Note: We need to get HD symbol next to signal, this HD indicates we can do VoLTE calls. I noticed that this HD vanishes after reboot, which means you can make calls or send SMS, again you need to disable-enable SIM to get HD symbol.
  
  Headphone: We need to thank Panasonic for giving headphone (Other brands do not give headphones). Headphone is good for handsfree calls, but sound quality is average to below average if used to listen music.
  

  Good Features : 2 Micro SIM slot with Dedicated SD card Slot.
  
  Gyroscope is not available. Although phone specs states it has Gyroscope, I was not able to detect Gyroscope using 2-3 apps.
  
  Fingerprint Sensor: Yet to be used.
  
  Arbo: You will get this after a 130 MB (Approximate) software update. Yet to get input from Arbo.
  

  Overall I am happy about this phone except for the in-call low speaker volume (Reduced 1 star for that).
  
  Hope this review was useful to know about this phone.

column7:
When I unboxed it, and was just holding it in my hands, the phone realized that theres a human holding it. So it powered on without me even pressing the power button.
  

  This phone has a really speedy fast charger. The disappointing thing is that it heats up a lot.
  

  It doesn't come with a regular charger.
  

  Earphones are good. I don't use earphones, but they sound good to me.
  

  Camera is OK. Flash on Front cam is good feature...
  

  Fingerprint is very convenient to hold. Fast enough for me... But it sometimes doesn't detect my finger. But those cases are rare.
  

  On some other phones, the camera, bluetooth or wifi would lag. That doesn't happen on this one...
  

  Battery is good enough for 1 day normal use. It runs on Android 6.0.1 Marshmallow, where there is a real power saver. With that it should last longer, it's useful while traveling.
  

  Touch is very smooth. The screen doesn't become dirty. The finger print sensor will become though...
  

  Although this phone actually has only 1 speaker, the sound is really good. Very loud, clear sound.
  

  The best thing about this phone is that is has 64GB internal storage. So you don't even need an SD card now!
  

  Internet connection is good. The back cover acts as the antenna. So, don't hold it tightly...
  

  With 4 GB RAM and a 1.4 GHz Octa COre processor, this phone is as good as a high end device!
  

  Lots of sensors. They all work very well...
  

  I have installed 160 apps, and the pre-installed apps are all up to date. And the phone hasn't lagged. (It hanged once, but that was Facebook Messenger's fault).
  

  A nice thing is that it's pure Android. Straight from Google. With no bloatware.
  

  There are some not so nice things about this, the "CE1313" mark at the back makes it look a bit ugly. The USB port is at the bottom of the phone, so that can be frustrating if you use your phone while charging. It's a heavy phone! Very heavy... But after just 3 days I got used to it...
  

  It's the best phone you can buy at this price. So go for it unless you have a higher budget...

That pink dot represents litmus paper which changed color from white to pink if comes into contact with water, i.e. my phone is water damaged. Though never used it in rain/very wet atmosphere ever.   Opinion: Don't go for this product. It's battery is very bad and don't even last for a year of normal usage. Company like Panasonic is taking customers as granted.

Pros. : 1) Budget smart phone,

  7) Flipkart quick service,
  
  8) No heating & hanging issue far,
  
  9) Handy , sleek with good appearance,
  
  10)Voice Clarity & good signal receiving capacity of mobile networks.
  
  11) Not a Hybrid Slot i.e you can insert 2 micro sim & 1 memory card in it.
  
  12) LED back lit panel which is a great features.
  
  Cons : 1) Accessories not available like Samsung if you want to buy from local market,
  
  2) Not OTG supported even not shows phone storage & memory card when you connect the phone with laptop ! which is very BAD ! Panasonic should update the issue by resolving the same.
  
  3) Front Camera & rear camera Panasonic declares 5 Megapixel , 16 Megapixel but in my opnion & usage it should 2 mega pixel VGA camera & 5 megapixel rear camera ! compared to Lenevo A7000 & Samsung J7 this is the actual condition.
  
  4) Battery is only 3000MaH which drains faster if you connect mobile using wifi / mobile data. it should 4000 Mah atleast.
  
  5) Display brightness is also not good. If you turn auto mode it is difficult to use the mobile in sunlight. No out door mode available like Samsung.
  
  6) Inbuilt phone Ringtones are very Bad.
  
  7) Lots of use less apps which consumes the phone storage.
  
  Finally,if you want a pocket friendly VOLTE supported , no hybrid slot with 32 GB ROM ,Brand value , in my opinion just go for it. Thats it.

Pros. : 1) Budget smart phone,

  10)Voice Clarity & good signal receiving capacity of mobile networks.
  
  11) Not a Hybrid Slot i.e you can insert 2 micro sim & 1 memory card in it.
  
  12) LED back lit panel which is a great features.
  
  Cons : 1) Accessories not available like Samsung if you want to buy from local market,
  
  2) Not OTG supported even not shows phone storage & memory card when you connect the phone with laptop ! which is very BAD ! Panasonic should update the issue by resolving the same.
  
  3) Front Camera & rear camera Panasonic declares 5 Megapixel , 16 Megapixel but in my opnion & usage it should 2 mega pixel VGA camera & 5 megapixel rear camera ! compared to Lenevo A7000 & Samsung J7 this is the actual condition.
  
  4) Battery is only 3000MaH which drains faster if you connect mobile using wifi / mobile data. it should 4000 Mah atleast.
  
  5) Display brightness is also not good. If you turn auto mode it is difficult to use the mobile in sunlight. No out door mode available like Samsung.
  
  6) Inbuilt phone Ringtones are very Bad.
  
  7) Lots of use less apps which consumes the phone storage.
  
  Finally,if you want a pocket friendly VOLTE supported , no hybrid slot with 32 GB ROM ,Brand value , in my opinion just go for it. Thats it.

Hi all...its going to be pretty long one..
  
  Actually when i bought it there wasnt a singke review about this set in flipkart..
  
  Bought the midnight blue colour in aug 2015 for rs10250 .got a company flip cover and extra screen protector of very good quality inside the box along with other regular accessories.both in imaculate condition still in dec 2016.
  
  Now coming to the phone..when i bought it back in 2015 i didnt have got the budget for a good samsung phone.wasnt happy with previous experience of micromax.so opted for this piece with a reliable brand name talking in its favour.
  
  Guys trust me..till date having no problem with it.i dont understand technology to its deep.what i can say is.:-
  
  Very decent looking piece.
  
  Using aircel 3g,superb speed here in kolkata.
  
  No reception problem on the second sim slot,using airtel.
  
  Good clarity of voice.
  
  Very decent battery.
  
  Tried with asus and sony power bank.no issues.i really keep my phone busy.
  
  Light heating issue if few apps are open at a time.fixed it through a clear master app.
  
  Awesome video recording quality.see it to believe me.
  
  Good rear camera indoor or outdoor.
  
  Selfie camera is good in daylight and with light sources in night.in low light its just ok.still itz got a flash for a rare click in total darkness.even samsung A5 or a7 dont.
  
  Not played high end games.a temple run or any shooting or air fighting games not an issue.
  
  Doesnt lag with multiple apps running.
  
  Only drawback in my eyes is not having a 4g connectivity.so no jio.but as said very good 3g speed.
  
  Loud speakers for call .
  
  Nice touch.
  
  Once had a problem.couldnt receive any call.the touch was not responding.solved it by going for factory reset.remember to go for a back up fot the data in the phone.doesnt effect memory card data.
  
  Thank you all for reading this and its my pleasure if the review have been of any help to you guys.

column6: Excellent mobile with decent range of options
column7:
I am using this phone for the past 3 days. The phone performs very good in terms of performance, although I am not satisfied with the camera. Low light images suffer from visible noise but they are still good enough to use.  In daylight the images captures are excellent, but indoors there is visible noise in the images. It is very speed and stylish. The camera also tends to oversaturate the colours at times. 1280X780 pixels display is great. Viewing outdoors or in direct sunlight is also very enjoyable as the display is not a reflective one.
  

  The engine its rocked with a 1.3 GHz Octa-core Mediatek chipset. To be specific its Mediatek 6753 which is a 64-bit processor. Along with that it comes with 3 GB of RAM as the primary memory. Running multiple apps or multitasking is a pleasant experience with the device. There are no memory management, lagging or heating issues or problems what so ever. Also you can run graphic intensive games without any drop in frames speed.
  

  Speaking of operating system it comes pre installed with the latest version of Android Marshmallow. The user interface is almost stock Android without any bloatwares or unnecessary apps that runs or consumes RAM on the background. Its smooth and clean UI.
  

  The device does supports USB OTG cable which users can connect pen drives, memory cards for instant file transfer without connecting it to a computer. However there is no USB Type-C reversible connector, but not a cons at all as it nowhere a flagship killer.  On the back panel there hoods a fingerprint scanner below the camera for security. Its fairly quick in responding and recognizing as well. Its always convenient to reach all the time as the index finger automatically rests on the fingerprint sensor.
  

  It has an IR (infrared) sensor for IR blaster which helps you to control your AC (air conditioner), TV (television), etc. And yes the other important sensors are also available like e-compass, gravity sensor, proximity sensor and ambient light sensor.
  

  For display protection it does not have Corning Gorilla Glass but an Asahi Dragontrail glass for protection from scratch and shatter. Actually the glass is a 2.5D curve design. Now is it comparable to Gorilla Glass for screen protection? Yes, its comparable and the reason Corning is so famous is because of their marketing. Dragontrail is also the second largest glass manufacturer for screen protection of smartphones. The entire body is made out of metal with high grade aluminum which feels very premium on the hands. Dimensionally its 7.7 mm thin with 76 mm width and 151 mm height. Overall from the design point of view its looks elegant.

column7:
At the time of writing this review I have used this phone for almost 5 days.
  
  I exchanged with my Mi4i. Got the product within 2 days of order.
  
  Pros :
  
  Looks great in hand and has a stylish back panel.
  
  Speakers are quite loud and this has impressed me a lot. You can easily hear it in the other room.
  
  Output from the 3.5 mm audio jack is also good.
  
  3GB of RAM ensures that there is no lag while multitasking.
  
  1.3 GHz Quad Core processor can handle most of the games. Remember, LCD is just an HD display so there is not much load on processor during gameplay.
  
  Heats very less. The only time it heated up a bit was when I put it on charge with 4G, Hotspot and GPS on.
  
  Battery backup is the best in this range. I left my home at 9 in the morning at full charge. 4G was on the whole day and a bit of normal usage, I returned at night around 11 with still 72% of juice left.
  
  Battery backup is great. Battery drops at about 5% an hour with 4G and hotspot ON.
  
  Network connectivity is good and has a rich call experience.
  
  A dedicated MicrSD card slot is also provided.
  
  Display quality is good (not the best) but still the brightness level is impressive.
  
  Fast charging charges the phone in a jiff.
  

  Cons:
  
  Not a great camera at this price segment. Front looks okayish but the pictures from the rear camera disappointed me a bit. Camera struggles in the low light condition. Maybe an OTA update will fix this.
  
  A bit on the heavier side with around 180 grams of weight.
  

  Improvements:
  
  System UI needs to be improved. It stopped responding a couple of times. Maybe an OTA update will fix this.
  
  Camera department needs a lot of work.
  

  I'd recommend this phone to those who are not a camera enthusiast.
